blocks.text: Hillcrest Digital secrets and access SOP

This is the working cut for HIL-SOP-2024-038 on July 25, 2024. Sam Reid asked for a written bound after the current path (Mixed 1Password and leftover .env files) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Aisha Rahman, Sam Reid, and Keisha Ward. Primary host vault.hillcrest.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on laptop .env as the system of record, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Per-client vault. Staff logins expire 7 days after pause. Break-glass is a logged path, not a file on a laptop. No secrets in ticket comments. I am not restating a hallway yes. laptop .env as the system of record is out because A .env on a travel laptop is how a leftover Harbor token lived for 9 months. Sam found it. It dies here. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at days=7, months=9, vaults=3, hours=0.8, weeks=2, laptop=1, glass=1, tickets=0. Sibling tickets HIL-2260 and HIL-SOP-2024-031. I will not reopen laptop .env as the system of record in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Sam Reid is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
